title.en: LZ 60 Diesel Concrete Pump — LZ-80, Yuchai — read beside “Flow Coefficient - C v”
title.zh: 共享的 6.6 米外形选不出 LZ-60 或 LZ-80——LZ-80，玉柴。——对照「流量系数 - C v」来读

description.en: LZ 60 Diesel Concrete Pump at /products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump. LZ-80, Yuchai 100 / 125 mm is on LZ-60
description.zh: 共享的 6.6 米外形选不出 LZ-60 或 LZ-80见 /products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump。LZ-80，玉柴。此处使用的 LZ-80 列表不印这根管子。

h1.en: Flow Factor - K v is the heading; LZ 60 Diesel Concrete Pump stays the subject
h1.zh: 标题是「流量因子 - K v」，主体仍是共享的 6.6 米外形选不出 LZ-60 或 LZ-80

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for LZ 60 Diesel Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump. LZ-80, Yuchai. 100 / 125 mm is on LZ-60. The LZ-80 list used here does not print that pipe. Diesel 120 prints 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm and 8000 kg. The order must name the engine and, for LZ-80, the mode. Quote 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m as printed, and add the weight of the path you mean. LZ-60 is 6105 / 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, conveying 100 m, height 300 m, pipe 100 / 125 mm and 5500 kg. A measured outline of 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m still leaves two diesel pages at Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. LZ-80 is Yuchai 256 kW, with high and low pressure modes, conveying 120 m, hopper 0.6 m³ and 6800 kg, and its delivery height says consult the factory standard. The section title “Flow Coefficient - C v” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是共享的 6.6 米外形选不出 LZ-60 或 LZ-80的数字。要打开的行是 /products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump。LZ-80，玉柴。此处使用的 LZ-80 列表不印这根管子。100 / 125 mm 在 LZ-60 上。订单必须点明发动机，对 LZ-80 还要点明模式。柴油120印 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm、8000 kg。按印出的 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m 引用，并加上你所指路径的重量。量到外形 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m，在河北品锦机械（邢台）仍然留下两张柴油页。LZ-80 是玉柴 256 kW，带高压和低压模式，输送距离 120 m，料斗 0.6 m³，6800 kg，输送高度写的是咨询工厂标准。LZ-60 是 6105 / 145 kW、50 m³/h、35 MPa、输送距离 100 m、高度 300 m、管径 100 / 125 mm、5500 kg。节标题「流量系数 - C v」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

body.en: “Flow Coefficient - C v” titles this part of the LZ 60 Diesel Concrete Pump note. The figures stay the printed ones. LZ-80, Yuchai. Diesel 120 prints 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm and 8000 kg. LZ-60 is 6105 / 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, conveying 100 m, height 300 m, pipe 100 / 125 mm and 5500 kg.
body.zh: 「流量系数 - C v」是共享的 6.6 米外形选不出 LZ-60 或 LZ-80这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。LZ-80，玉柴。柴油120印 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm、8000 kg。100 / 125 mm 在 LZ-60 上。

body.en: For LZ 60 Diesel Concrete Pump, the heading “Flow Factor - K v” does not replace a cell. 100 / 125 mm is on LZ-60. The order must name the engine and, for LZ-80, the mode. A measured outline of 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m still leaves two diesel pages at Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai.
body.zh: 对共享的 6.6 米外形选不出 LZ-60 或 LZ-80而言，标题「流量因子 - K v」并不替换任何格子。LZ-60 是 6105 / 145 kW、50 m³/h、35 MPa、输送距离 100 m、高度 300 m、管径 100 / 125 mm、5500 kg。订单必须点明发动机，对 LZ-80 还要点明模式。量到外形 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m，在河北品锦机械（邢台）仍然留下两张柴油页。

heading.en: Converting between Flow Coefficient C v and Flow Factor K v
heading.zh: 换算 之间 流量系数 C v与流量因子 K v

body.en: LZ 60 Diesel Concrete Pump is unchanged by the heading “Converting between Flow Coefficient C v and Flow Factor K v”. The LZ-80 list used here does not print that pipe. Quote 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m as printed, and add the weight of the path you mean. LZ-80 is Yuchai 256 kW, with high and low pressure modes, conveying 120 m, hopper 0.6 m³ and 6800 kg, and its delivery height says consult the factory standard. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/flow-coefficient-factor-d_238.html.
body.zh: 共享的 6.6 米外形选不出 LZ-60 或 LZ-80不因标题「换算 之间 流量系数 C v与流量因子 K v」而改动。此处使用的 LZ-80 列表不印这根管子。按印出的 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m 引用，并加上你所指路径的重量。LZ-80 是玉柴 256 kW，带高压和低压模式，输送距离 120 m，料斗 0.6 m³，6800 kg，输送高度写的是咨询工厂标准。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/flow-coefficient-factor-d_238.html。

question.en: Does “Flow Coefficient - C v” replace LZ-80, Yuchai?
question.zh: 「流量系数 - C v」会替换「LZ-80，玉柴。」吗？

answer.en: No. LZ-80, Yuchai remains the printed wording for LZ 60 Diesel Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。LZ-80，玉柴。仍是共享的 6.6 米外形选不出 LZ-60 或 LZ-80已印的说法。

question.en: Where does 100 / 125 mm is on LZ-60 belong on the LZ 60 Diesel Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 共享的 6.6 米外形选不出 LZ-60 或 LZ-80这一行里，「此处使用的 LZ-80 列表不印这根管子。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Flow Factor - K v” add to LZ 60 Diesel Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「流量因子 - K v」给共享的 6.6 米外形选不出 LZ-60 或 LZ-80增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/flow-coefficient-factor-d_238.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/flow-coefficient-factor-d_238.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
